identificationModule.briefTitle: An Efficacy and Safety Study of Apalutamide (JNJ-56021927) in Combination With Abiraterone Acetate and Prednisone Versus Abiraterone Acetate and Prednisone in Participants With Chemotherapy-naive Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3 Randomized, Placebo-controlled Double-blind Study of JNJ-56021927 in Combination With Abiraterone Acetate and Prednisone Versus Abiraterone Acetate and Prednisone in Subjects With Chemotherapy-naive Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC)

armGroups.label: Group 1: AAP and apalutamide
armGroups.description: Participants will receive apalutamide 240 milligram (mg) (4\*60 mg tablets) and abiraterone acetate (AA) 1000 mg (4\*250 mg tablets) once daily on an empty stomach and 5 mg prednisone (P), AAP, twice daily, until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity or end of treatment, whichever occurs first. After unblinding participants will be offered further treatment as defined in the Open-Label Extension (OLE) or Long-Term Extension (LTE) phase (AAP + open label apalutamide or AAP alone).

armGroups.label: Group 2: AAP and Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants will receive matching Placebo of apalutamide and abiraterone acetate (AA) 1000 mg (4\*250 mg tablets) once daily on an empty stomach and 5 mg prednisone (P), AAP, twice daily until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity or end of treatment, whichever occurs first. After unblinding participants will be offered further treatment as defined in the OLE or LTE phase (AAP + open label apalutamide or AAP alone).

interventions.name: Apalutamide
interventions.description: Participants will receive 240 mg (4\*60 mg tablets) of apalutamide once daily orally.

interventions.name: Abiraterone acetate
interventions.description: Participants will receive 1000 mg (4\*250 mg tablets) of abiraterone acetate (AA) once daily orally.

interventions.name: Prednisone
interventions.description: Participants will receive 5 mg tablet of prednisone twice daily orally.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Participants will receive matching placebo to apalutamide once daily orally.
